question: Does time-local observability in the two least-stable measured modal bands add useful boundary/decision information beyond the existing 50/50 spatial blend and global band/aperture controls?
scope: 77 original TRAIN designs, 4454 underlying clips, original five outer design folds, proper-fit/calibration split seed947+fold, model seeds42/43/44. Reserved selection/calibration/test splits remain untouched. No structural simulation or production change; GRU remains live.
source: Ueda-Iio-Ikeda 2009, DOI10.2322/tjsass.51.275: borrow local observability, not its absolute-amplitude index, target-calculated flutter band or speed-sweep extrapolation.
acquisition: Replay existing37 acquisition conditions exactly: raw 25-location sensor cache, existing selected16 channels, original51-sample causal per-channel RMS calibration, gain perturbation and +/-50 cap. Features use only samples before the first capped sample in any selected channel. Match cached usable fractions and measured band frequencies. Read raw/noise_scale/source_indices, never poles or solver critical-frequency labels.
bands: Cached measured features columns28 and31: first/second least-stable >=1%-fitted-component-energy modes. These are observed candidate bands, not oracle flutter-mode identities. Gaussian complex sinusoid with sigma_time=2/f, truncated at3sigma (+/-6 observed cycles). Only complete kernel support; at least8 valid center samples. Kernel envelope sums to1. Magnitude removes global phase sensitivity. This deliberately differs from the paper's real transform and four-cycle sigma to fit short records; bandwidth/support fixed before scoring, no sweep.
local_definitions: Band power=sum_channels|Gaussian-windowed complex coefficient|^2. Local total power=sum_channels Gaussian-smoothed squared signal. Share=band/total; ratio and all descriptors invariant to positive global amplitude scaling. Gaussian and band convolution use identical valid centers. Log power floor=1e-12 times maximum band power. Trend fitted over physical center times; local RMSE measures departure from its global line. Insufficient support or zero excitation: available=0 and no invented band quantities; usable fraction/cycles retained. Clip-wide scale normalization inside extraction is numerical only.

arms.blend_frozen: Unmodified proper-fit frozen107/174-member50/50 blend; exact point replay against earlier recorded baseline.
arms.blend_global: Append12 global band/aperture controls to both107/174 members, refit on proper-fit designs and average50/50.
arms.blend_local: Append12 global and12 local descriptors to both members; same refit/50/50 blend.
arms.blend_sham: Same dimensions as blend_local; retain global controls but permute joint12 local descriptors among underlying clips separately within proper-fit, calibration and held partitions. Same clip permutation across acquisition copies. Diagnostic only, not a deployable predictor.

fitting: Existing MLP32->16 ReLU L-BFGS alpha1/tol1e-7/max_iter10000/max_fun200000; original equal four-view independent-noise training only. Scaling fitted only on proper-fit rows. All acquisition copies of a design remain in the same partition. No residual correction head, soft constraint or joint physical prior; rejected residual/scale integration remains out of the active path. Ninety new member fits (3 additions x2 members x3 seeds x5 folds).
calibration: Same design-disjoint calibration rows for all arms. Constant raw90% absolute-residual radius; design-group-max90% radius with finite-sample ceil((n_designs+1)*.9) order statistic. Gaussian residual-RMS instability probability is a numerical comparator, not a Bayesian posterior or validated error law. Stable calibration warning budgets1/5/10/20%; thresholds chosen on calibration only. Local descriptors do not automatically provide calibrated confidence or a new abstention policy.
evaluation: Keep all37 conditions descriptive; compare local versus frozen/global/sham. Design MAE, signed-error exceedance, stable/unstable last1/2/5%, farther-stable underestimation, raw/group intervals and safe availability, Brier/log score, calibrated stable false-warning and unstable miss rates. Report seeds separately, two noise draws and paired2000 whole-design bootstrap retaining seeds/copies together. Previously scored acquisitions and repeated exploratory decisions: no blind confirmation, refit uncertainty or multiplicity guarantee.
diagnostics: Report band availability/support loss by condition and margin slice. On held-design predictions only, associate local log-power-fit residual with frozen boundary errors using clean-training fixed quartile cutoffs; these are descriptive associations, not causal reliability or a deployment cutoff. No dropping poorly observed clips.
decision: No automatic adoption. Require attribution beyond global and equal-dimension sham controls and useful boundary/decision behavior, not just aggregate MAE. Strict zero-deterioration upper-bound screens are conservative exploratory guardrails, not formal noninferiority. Record negative or inconclusive results without feature/width/noise retuning.
timing: Report incremental local extraction and cached-base-feature-to-point/distribution runtimes on actual held clips; include both refitted blend members. Existing full modal/spatial extraction is excluded and must be labeled; do not claim full sensor-to-output latency.
